WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.dbn,
    t1.school_name,
    t2.dbn AS t2_dbn,
    t2.code1,
    t3.school_name AS t3_school_name,
    t3.program1,
    t4.code1 AS t4_code1,
    t4.fax_number,
    t5.fax_number AS t5_fax_number,
    t5.method1
  FROM `node_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `2020 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
  INNER JOIN `2020 DOE High School Directory_nyc_high_school_directory` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
  INNER JOIN `2020 DOE High School Directory_high_school_programs_info` t4 ON t2.code1 = t4.code1
  INNER JOIN `2020 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_1` t5 ON t4.fax_number = t5.fax_number
  WHERE t1.college_career_rate IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    dbn,
    school_name,
    code1,
    program1,
    method1,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY dbn, school_name, code1, program1, method1) AS average
  FROM base_data
  GROUP BY dbn, school_name, code1, program1, method1
)
SELECT 
  dbn,
  school_name,
  code1,
  program1,
  method1,
  total,
  count,
  average
FROM aggregated
WHERE total > 0
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH ranked_data AS (SELECT t3.city_council_district, t3.total_units, t3.boiler_installation_date, t3.boiler_model, t5.of_res_units, t5.of_floors, t5.owner_telephone, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t3.city_council_district ORDER BY t3.total_units DESC) as row_num FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot WHERE t3.total_units IS NOT NULL) SELECT city_council_district, total_units, boiler_installation_date, boiler_model, of_res_units, of_floors, owner_telephone FROM ranked_data WHERE row_num <= 5

SELECT t3.city_council_district, t5.nta, SUM(t3.total_units) AS total, AVG(t3.total_units) AS average, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot GROUP BY t3.city_council_district, t5.nta

WITH categorized_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.building_manager AS t1_building_manager,
    t3.building_manager AS t3_building_manager,
    t1.total_gallons_high,
    t3.city_council_district,
    t3.total_units,
    t5.of_res_units,
    CASE 
      WHEN t1.total_gallons_high > 150000 THEN 'very_high_usage'
      WHEN t1.total_gallons_high > 50000 THEN 'high_usage'
      ELSE 'moderate_or_low_usage'
    END AS category
  FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1
  INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application
  INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager
  INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner
  INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot
  WHERE t3.total_units IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  t1_building_manager,
  t3_building_manager,
  city_council_district,
  total_units,
  of_res_units,
  category,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  AVG(total_gallons_high) AS avg_value,
  SUM(total_gallons_high) AS total_value,
  MAX(total_gallons_high) AS max_value
FROM categorized_data
GROUP BY 
  t1_building_manager,
  t3_building_manager,
  city_council_district,
  total_units,
  of_res_units,
  category

SELECT t1.building_manager, t3.building_manager, t1.dep_boiler_application, t1.total_gallons_high, t3.city_council_district, t3.total_units, t5.of_res_units, SUM(t1.total_gallons_high) AS total_fuel_usage FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot GROUP BY t1.building_manager, t3.building_manager, t1.dep_boiler_application, t1.total_gallons_high, t3.city_council_district, t3.total_units, t5.of_res_units

WITH base_data AS (SELECT t2.primary_fuel, t2.total_mmbtu_low, t2.total_mmbtu_high, t3.city_council_district, t3.total_units, t5.of_res_units, t5.of_floors FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot WHERE t2.total_mmbtu_low IS NOT NULL), aggregated AS (SELECT city_council_district, primary_fuel, SUM(total_mmbtu_low) as total, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(total_mmbtu_low) as average FROM base_data GROUP BY city_council_district, primary_fuel) SELECT city_council_district, primary_fuel, total, count, average FROM aggregated WHERE total > 0 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT t3.city_council_district AS fact_column, SUM(t2.total_mmbtu_low) AS total_dimension1, AVG(t5.of_res_units) AS average_dimension2, t3.total_units, t2.primary_fuel, t5.of_floors FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1 INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot GROUP BY t3.city_council_district, t3.total_units, t2.primary_fuel, t5.of_floors

SELECT t3.building_manager, SUM(t1.total_gallons_high) AS total_high_gallons FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot GROUP BY t3.building_manager

WITH ranked AS (SELECT t3.city_council_district, t3.total_units, t4.borough_block_lot, t4.boiler_capacity_gross_btu, t4.utility, t5.borough_block_lot as ownership_borough_block_lot, t5.of_res_units, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t4.utility ORDER BY t4.boiler_capacity_gross_btu DESC) as rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t3.city_council_district ORDER BY t3.total_units) as dense_rank FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot) SELECT city_council_district, total_units, borough_block_lot, boiler_capacity_gross_btu, utility, ownership_borough_block_lot, of_res_units, rank, dense_rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 5

SELECT t3.city_council_district, t3.total_units, t4.borough_block_lot, t4.boiler_capacity_gross_btu, t5.borough_block_lot, SUM(t5.of_res_units) AS total_residential_units FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot GROUP BY t3.city_council_district, t3.total_units, t4.borough_block_lot, t4.boiler_capacity_gross_btu, t5.borough_block_lot

WITH ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.building_manager,
    t3.building_manager AS t3_building_manager,
    t4.borough_block_lot,
    t5.borough_block_lot AS t5_borough_block_lot,
    t3.total_units,
    t3.boiler_installation_date,
    t4.boiler_capacity_gross_btu,
    t5.of_res_units,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t4.borough_block_lot ORDER BY t3.total_units DESC) AS row_num
  FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1
  INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application
  INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager
  INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner
  INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot
  WHERE t3.total_units IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  building_manager,
  t3_building_manager,
  borough_block_lot,
  t5_borough_block_lot,
  total_units,
  boiler_installation_date,
  boiler_capacity_gross_btu,

SELECT t1.building_manager, SUM(t1.total_gallons_high) AS total_fuel_usage, t3.building_manager, t4.borough_block_lot, t5.borough_block_lot, t3.total_units, t5.of_res_units FROM `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_boiler_fuel_usage_records` t1
INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.building_manager = t3.building_manager

)

    ON t1.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_condo_section = t2.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_condo_section
  INNER JOIN `DOF： Condominium Comparable Rental Income – Manhattan – FY 2011 2012_manhattan_condo_rental_comparables` t3 
    ON t1.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_address = t3.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_address
  INNER JOIN `node_4` t4 
    ON t1.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_boro_block_lot = t4.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_boro_block_lot
  INNER JOIN `DOF： Condominium Comparable Rental Income – Manhattan – FY 2011 2012_manhattan_condo_rental_income_1` t5

  INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_1` t3 ON t1.latitude = t3.latitude AND t1.longitude = t3.longitude

  INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory` t7 ON t4.bin = t7.bin
  WHERE t5.categoriesaccepted IS NOT NULL

  SELECT 
    objectid,
    latitude,

    address,

    t3_latitude,
